description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Nationwide is a technology organization supporting innovation and customer-focused solutions for its financial services business. The Software Engineer will develop, test, secure, deploy, document, and maintain software applications using technologies such as Java, Angular, and AWS while collaborating with business partners and engineering teams.
Entry-level software engineer developing, securing, testing, and deploying Java and Angular applications on AWS

Responsibilities:
• Develop, test, debug, document, and deploy software according to engineering standards and best practices
• Apply secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities
• Use DevSecOps practices, tooling, and techniques
• Demonstrate continuous improvement and learning
• Review and process project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables proactively
• May perform other responsibilities as assigned

Requirements:
• The ideal candidate will have experience with Java, Angular and AWS
• Technology experience or non-traditional technology certificates can be substituted for an undergraduate degree
• Early career opportunity with one or more years of technology experience
• Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, C++, Python, JavaScript
• Knowledge of software development lifecycle
• Good problem-solving skills
• Ability to thrive in a team environment

Preferred:
• Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems or other related degrees are preferred
• Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus
